source.title: A survey of some results and open problems in weighted inductive limits and projective description for spaces of holomorphic functions

trace.notes: Original input normalized as the zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/1819605.

Resolver recovery identified zbMATH record 1819605 as the article 'A survey of some results and open problems in weighted inductive limits and projective description for spaces of holomorphic functions' by Klaus D. Bierstedt, published in Bulletin de la Societe Royale des Sciences de Liege 70 (2001), no. 4-6, pages 167-182, with Zbl 1030.46002. Local shard metadata and zbMATH/PoPuPS search surfaces point to the PoPuPS article page https://popups.uliege.be/0037-9565/index.php?format=print&id=1836 as the exact source.

Failure mode metadata_only with local network_or_dns_failure and unreadable primary-source fetch: local curl attempts to zbMATH/API hosts failed with DNS resolution errors in the sandbox, direct browser/page fetches of the zbMATH record and the exact PoPuPS article page did not return readable full text, and exact-title searches exposed only snippets, resolver listings, the sitemap title, citation metadata, and references from other works. The likely PoPuPS PDF pattern https://popups.uliege.be/0037-9565/pdf.php?id=1836 could not be reached as a discoverable readable artifact through the available page links. No open questions were extracted because the accessible material did not provide a full primary-source body or complete problem statements.
Input could not be normalized to a readable PDF or HTML full-text source. Search snippets and bibliographic metadata were rejected as extraction evidence under the source-adequacy gate.
Saved exact JSON payload to outputs/parse-paper/1819605.json and outputs/latest.json.
